		StaticText "I've had this camera for about a year and a half now. I use it a lot and have explored many of the different features it has.Pros:the color is gorgeous! This is probably my biggest complaint with this camera.Couples timer doesn't seem to work so well- it jumps the gun everytime I try it. I like the 10 second timer instead.still haven't figured out how the facial recognition feature benefits me.It's a pain in the [...] to cycle around the menu and pick the picture mode you want.
